notes_app_level: ★resolved earlier a11y-empty gotcha: must use MAIN electron process(pgrep pattern 'Visual Studio Code.app/Contents/MacOS', NOT the generic 'Visual Studio Code' name-match which can hit a Helper-process with 0 a11y elements) + click-to-focus-first before query.

items.label: Open…
items.notes: per a_2546 safe-click-whitelist, opens file-picker dialog(cancelable, non-destructive)

items.label: Save All
items.notes: saves all open editors, non-destructive(saving, not deleting)

items.label: Revert File
items.notes: ★destructive-adjacent(discards unsaved changes, reverts to disk version), skip

items.label: Close Folder [⌘K F]
items.notes: close workspace, reversible via Open Recent

recent_files_submenu.structure: workspace-folders-list(recent ~/-paths) THEN files-list(recent individual file paths) THEN action-items

action_items.label: More…
action_items.notes: opens full recent-items list dialog, non-destructive

action_items.label: Clear Recently Opened…
action_items.notes: ★DESTRUCTIVE-adjacent(clears history list, not files themselves, but irreversible list-wipe), observe-only per pattern

recent_files_submenu.notes: confirms cross-app pattern: 'Open Recent'/'최근 사용한 파일 열기'-type submenu = 2-tier list(recent-items + management-actions), management-actions(Clear/Remove-from-list) = flag as destructive-adjacent even though it doesn't delete actual files
